$comment: Provenance for the vendored route snapshot. Same shape and same purpose as source.json: a vendored artefact that cannot say where it came from is one nobody can tell is stale. `commit` is where the snapshot was TAKEN; `reverifiedAt` is the latest backend commit the surface was checked against and found identical — the staleness check:routes says in its own docblock that it cannot see.
vendoredBy: TAB 19 — re-vendored after the sector endpoints
reverifiedBy: DL-159 — `php artisan lguids:routes` run read-only against the backend at that commit and diffed against this artefact: 293 routes, none added, none removed. The snapshot is unchanged and its sha256 still matches; only the record of what it was checked against moved.
